# pvecli node reboot

Reboot a node. Proxmox will stop all guests before rebooting.

```text
pvecli node reboot [NODE] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `NODE` | Node name. |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
